title: Whether Client Connector installs the Zscaler root certificate

prose.text: Why a device without the root sees errors on inspected traffic is in [[zia.ssl-inspection.certificates:root-must-be-trusted]]; applications with their own trust stores need more, as [[zia.ssl-inspection.certificates:own-trust-stores]] explains.

prose.label: iOS.
prose.text: {{no-ios-option}} Client Connector does not install it there, and Zscaler recommends installing it through the MDM: [[zcc.ssl-inspection.certificate-install:ios]].

prose.label: Other platforms.
prose.text: Who installs the certificate on each platform, and when: [[zcc.ssl-inspection.certificate-install]].

prose.label: Built by hand.
prose.text: The key that carries the setting differs by platform and by source: [[zcc.api.web-policy-wire:os-password-key-casing]].
Certificate trust on the endpoint beyond the app profile is in [[zcc.ssl-inspection]].

checks.do: Whether the rule the device downloaded, for its platform, has Install Zscaler SSL Certificate on.
On iOS, whether MDM delivered the certificate, since the app profile has no option for it.
For a body built by hand, which key the platform block used.

purpose.statement: An app profile determines whether the app can install the Zscaler SSL certificate on users' devices, to allow SSL inspection of traffic the app forwards to Internet & SaaS.

quotes: Determine whether the app can install the Zscaler SSL certificate on users' devices to allow SSL inspection of traffic forwarded by the app for the Internet & SaaS service.

install-option.statement: With Install Zscaler SSL Certificate enabled, the app installs the Zscaler certificate automatically, or the organization's custom certificate if one was uploaded; deployments using the app for Private Access only skip the option.

evidence.after: The Add Windows Policy window appears.
quotes: If you're using Zscaler Client Connector for Private Access (ZPA) only, skip this option. Enable this option to allow Zscaler Client Connector to automatically install the Zscaler SSL certificate on
If you uploaded your organization's custom certificate in the Zscaler Admin Console, the app installs your organization's custom certificate instead.

no-ios-option.statement: The iOS app profile has no certificate setting: the iOS section of the help, the API's `iosPolicy` block and the Go SDK's iOS block carry none.
no-ios-option.conditions: Absence: the iOS section of the app profile article, the OpenAPI iosPolicy properties and the Go IosPolicy struct were searched for a certificate setting; Windows, macOS, Linux and Android blocks all have one.

evidence.note: The iosPolicy property list holds passwords, passcode, ipv6Mode and showVPNTunNotification only.
